limitations_and_boundaries: Correlative nature of the study; assumes microglia are responding to amyloid.
snRNA-seq analysis focused on male cases only.
Sparsity of snRNA-seq data may limit detection of some markers.
Differences between human ARM and mouse DAM populations; limited gene overlap.
CD163 expression is binary, limiting quantitative gradation.

experiments_or_tasks: Cell-specific network (CSN) analysis with Metacell preprocessing.
GO enrichment analysis of differentially expressed genes.
Single-nucleus RNA sequencing of postmortem human brain with varied APOE and TREM2 genotypes and neuropathology.
Trajectory reconstruction to infer relationships among subpopulations.
Unsupervised clustering using DESC to identify microglia subpopulations.

methods.name: DESC clustering
methods.protocol_description: Unsupervised deep-embedding algorithm for single-cell clustering that performs iterative machine-learning-based clustering and provides cluster assignment probabilities.

methods.name: Differential expression analysis
methods.protocol_description: Wilcoxon rank-sum test with Benjamini-Hochberg correction (P<0.05) and log2-fold change >0.1, using SCANPY 1.4.2.

methods.name: GO enrichment analysis
methods.protocol_description: Statistical overrepresentation test using PANTHER with binomial test and FDR correction (FDR<0.05) on Biological Processes ontology.

methods.name: Cell-specific network (CSN) analysis
methods.protocol_description: Modified CSN method from Dai et al. with adapted window sizes; applied after Metacell aggregation to reduce sparsity. Networks compared using a multivariate data change point test.

study_units.name: snRNA-seq microglia subpopulation identification
